subject: Post-call: Sentry Health compliance scope proposal & next steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jen Saito <jen.saito@sentryhealth.com>
Cc: securityops@sentryhealth.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Sentry Health compliance scope proposal & next steps

Hi Jen — great to speak with you and the security team earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of call:
- You confirmed Sentry Health is evaluating vendors for both SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance for the upcoming pilot.
- Current in-scope systems: patient-data ingestion, model serving, and the data lake access layer (engineering/infra scope).
- Timeline: target pilot launch in Q4, audit window for SOC 2 expected late Q4 / early Q1.

Redwood action items (proposed):
1) Share a short SOC 2 readiness summary and our standard evidence checklist (attached).
2) Send our vendor security questionnaire for your team to review and fill (attached: vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf).
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) to review audit logs, encryption/KMS design, and network segmentation. Proposed window: Apr 25–29 (we can be flexible).
4) Provide the mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone dates and an initial scope proposal (attached MAP v2).

Questions for you/ask of Sentry Health:
- Please confirm whether PHI will be transmitted in the pilot (HIPAA applicability).
- Any additional regulatory constraints (state-level patient data residency) we should consider?

Next suggested steps:
- Jen/Security ops: confirm HIPAA applicability and preferred date for the technical deep-dive.
- Redwood: share readiness summary and MAP (sending now).

Attachments (stubs): vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (fillable), mutual_action_plan_Sentry_v2.xlsx (MAP draft).

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference platform
From: Jen Saito <jen.saito@sentryhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: securityops@sentryhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-18T15:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Sentry Health compliance scope proposal & next steps

Thanks Grace — quick responses inline.

Appreciate the clear recap. A few items: 
- Confirmed: PHI WILL be in scope for the pilot (we will share sample payloads with redaction guidance).
- SOC 2 status: we are in a readiness phase now (controls being documented) and expect to engage an auditor in Q4. We do not yet have a report to share.
- For the deep-dive, can you provide a short list of the specific logs and retention windows you rely on for anomaly detection? Our security ops will want to validate retention and access patterns.

We will review the questionnaire — expect our security ops to start filling it out next week. Proposed deep-dive: Apr 26 11:00 AM PT — does that work for your team?

On the artifacts front, can Redwood provide a high-level SOC 2 readiness summary and sample control mappings (e.g., control owner, evidence type)? If you have a short one-pager, that would accelerate our procurement review.

Thanks — will loop in procurement if we get to contract terms, but security needs to complete the intake before procurement engages.

Regards,
Jen Saito
Head of Security Operations, Sentry Health
jen.saito@sentryhealth.com
securityops@sentryhealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call: Sentry Health compliance scope proposal & next steps

Hi Jen — Marcus from Redwood infra/security on the thread. Thanks for confirming PHI in scope. A few quick notes and what we can provide before the deep-dive: 

What we'll share now (attached):
- redwood_soc2_readiness_summary.pdf — one-pager with control mappings (logical), current evidence cadence, and expected audit timeline.
- Example log list and retention windows (included in the PDF appendix): auth logs (90 days), app access logs (365 days), KV cache access (30 days), and long-term audit snapshots (S3) retained per contract.

On the deep-dive (technical):
- We can present the log schema, how we grant cross-account readonly access for auditors, and our KMS envelope flow.
- Proposed deep-dive slots: Apr 25 10:00 AM PT or Apr 26 11:00 AM PT. Grace will coordinate calendars — please confirm preference.

Notes on scope: based on your in-scope areas we recommend the initial SOC 2 scope cover: Infrastructure & Platform + Inference Runtime + Data Access Controls. That keeps the pilot auditable while minimizing control surface. If you want to include the orchestration layer, we can expand, but that usually adds 3–4 weeks to evidence collection.

[Internal: if procurement expects an executed BAA, we should queue draft language and get legal involved early. — Marcus] 

Attachments (stubs): redwood_soc2_readiness_summary.pdf

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Thanks Jen — Apr 26 11:00 AM PT works for us. I've created a calendar invite and added the HubSpot deal link for reference. 

Action items captured: 
- Sentry: start questionnaire, confirm any state residency constraints, share sample payload (redacted) if possible.
- Redwood: circulate redwood_soc2_readiness_summary.pdf, prepare deep-dive slide deck focusing on logs/KMS/audit access, and queue a BAA draft if procurement will need it.

I'll mark the MAP milestones in the HubSpot deal and update the timeline once we agree scope in the deep-dive.

Thanks all — see you on Apr 26.

Best,
Grace
